description.describe_ch: 本課程藉由企業舞弊個案分析，輔以基本會計學、財務理論，稅務法規與審計準則基礎理論，了解企業可能發生舞弊、財報不實及稅務規避等原因及可能面臨的問題。同時整合多個面向的知識，提出其他有利於企業的決策與方法。
description.describe_eh: This course utilizes the analysis of corporate fraud cases along with basic accounting, financial theories, and basic theories of tax regulations and auditing standards. This course aims to understand the causes and problems that enterprises may face such as fraud, false financial statements and tax avoidance. At the same time, it integrates multiple aspects of knowledge and proposes other decisions and methods that are beneficial to the enterprise.

targets.describe_ch: 能綜合企業舞弊案例分析的可採用的會計、財務與稅務理論，整合跨領域及解決問題的能力
targets.describe_en: Integrate applicable accounting, finance and tax theories based on corporate fraud case studies, integrating cross-disciplinary and problem-solving skills

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
• NO MAKE-UP EXAMS. Missed tests will count as zero unless absence is authorized in advance by the instructor.
      • Make-up exam may be arranged for just cause. For official leave, you need to provide supporting document with endorsement from related party or agency AND inform the instructor at least TWO weeks before the exam date(s). For sick leave, please produce medical certificate from public hospital or clinic.
 
    • Exam Policies:
      • Permitted items are strictly limited to two: (1) pencil/pen and (2) basic 4-function calculator, with no lids/covers. Pencils and calculators may not be shared, and won’t be provided.
      • Switch off your mobile phone or switch it to silence mode during the exam
      • Students are strictly prohibited from talking or having any form of communication during the exam
      • You are not allowed to enter the examination hall to take the exam if you arrive 15 minutes after the exam starts
 
  • ◎Fairness of Grade Policy
    •    Marks awarded in each component of assessments will be done in an objective and fair manner.  All exam markings will be done with care and double-checked before entering into the system.
    •    Lecturers reserve the right to make an adjustment of students’ FINAL grades; however, such an adjustment will be made in a systematic manner (i.e., class as a whole). Lecturers will NOT entertain student’s individual request for marks or final irrespective of reasons.  Student who attempts to violate the fairness of grade policy by approaching lecturer to request for higher grade or “pass” will be subject to a penalty of 10-mark loss in his/her FINAL grade.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: 本課程以實體上課為主，教師期望學生能遵守以下課堂禮儀和行為規範：準時到達上課、尊重教師和同學、積極參與討論、遵守設定的課堂規則等。這些規範有助於營造良好的學習環境，促進有效的知識傳遞和互動。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
To ensure a conducive learning environment and effectiveness, we hope everyone can adhere to the following classroom etiquette and online etiquette:

Physical Classroom Space:

Arrive punctually for class and respect the teaching time.
Listen attentively and respect the contributions of the instructor and classmates.
When asking questions or participating in discussions, maintain politeness and respect different viewpoints.
Keep mobile phones on silent mode to avoid disturbing others.
Virtual Online Space:

Respect others' opinions during online discussions and refrain from using inappropriate language or behavior.
Maintain a stable internet connection to ensure smooth participation.
Share valuable information and reference resources to enrich everyone's learning experience.
Adhere to online meeting protocols such as muting when not speaking and waiting for the opportunity to contribute.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: In this course, we collectively pursue depth of knowledge and growth. Please maintain focus during classes and actively participate in discussions, as this aids in better understanding and mastering course content. In addition to classes, reading textbooks, referencing resources provided by the instructor, and engaging in group discussions are all effective ways to enhance learning.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: 期望學生在學習評量中展現誠信，遵守考試規則和作業要求。在班上互動時，尊重他人觀點，避免抄襲、偽造資料等不誠信行為。課程結束後，學生應尊重學術道德，避免未經授權使用他人作品。若發現學術不誠信，可能面臨處分，包括警告、扣分、退課或學術處分等，以維護學術公正和學習環境的健康。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
• ◎Academic Integrity
    Per university policy, students shall not plagiarize, cheat, or falsify or misuse academic records. Students are expected to adhere to University policy on cheating and plagiarism in all courses. The minimum penalty for a first offense is a zero on the assignment on which the offense occurred. If the offense is considered severe or the student has other academic offenses on their record, more serious penalties, up to suspension from the university may be imposed.
    Plagiarism and cheating are serious breaches of academic conduct. When students submit work purporting to be their own, but which in any way borrows ideas, organization, wording or anything else from another source without appropriate acknowledgement of the fact, the students are guilty of plagiarism. Plagiarism includes reproducing someone else’s work, whether it be a published article, chapter of a book, a paper from a friend or some file, or something similar to this. Plagiarism includes the practice of employing or allowing another person to alter or revise the work which a student submits as his/her own, whoever that other person may be.
 
  • ◎Disclaimer
    All policies discussed herein are subject to the official University Regulations. If there is a discrepancy between and of our policies and the University policies, the official policies shall reign. Also, we reserve the right to modify any part of this syllabus to your advantage during the semester after giving adequate notice of such changes (e.g. extend due dates).
